mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.title, i.author, i.summary, i.content, i.views, i.likes, i.collects, i.publish_date AS `date`, c.code AS category, c.name AS categoryName, co.name AS companyName, co.avatar_text AS avatar, co.avatar_color AS avatarColor, co.description AS companyDesc, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.name ORDER BY t.id ASC SEPARATOR ',') AS tagsStr FROM interview i JOIN category c ON i.category_id = c.id JOIN company co ON i.company_id = co.id LEFT JOIN interview_tag it ON i.id = it.interview_id LEFT JOIN tag t ON it.tag_id = t.id WHERE i.id = #{id} AND i.status = 1 GROUP BY i.id, i.title, i.author, i.summary, i.content, i.views, i.likes, i.collects, i.publish_date, c.code, c.name, co.name, co.avatar_text, co.avatar_color, co.description
mapper.update: UPDATE interview SET views = views + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE interview SET likes = likes + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE interview SET collects = collects + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, sort_order FROM category ORDER BY sort_order ASC
